notes: Seven previously uncontacted technical recruiting founders with Hunter-valid company-domain emails.
No URLs or tracking links are included. Recipients are invited to find Hirelix through Google.
Every email states the business relevance and includes an opt-out plus mailing-address placeholder.
Final sending requires recipient and copy confirmation plus configured sender and postal address.

emails.subject: Would you try Hirelix on one AI role?
emails.body:
Hi Neil,

I'm Noah, founder of Hirelix. I built it for technical recruiters who spend too much time finding profiles and comparing technical evidence before deciding who deserves outreach.

Hirelix turns a client JD into a ranked pool of real technical profiles, with fit reasons, risks to verify, and editable outreach drafts. It is designed to reduce repetitive sourcing work while leaving recruiter judgment and candidate relationships with you.

Scale-Ability's focus on AI/ML and software roles made me think this may be relevant. Would you be open to trying it on one role and telling me bluntly what is missing?

There is no link in this email. You can Google "Hirelix" if you would like to take a look.

Best,
Noah

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}
